name: Grok Build
description: Terminal-based AI coding agent from xAI that operates as a full-screen TUI, understands codebases, edits files, and executes commands. Achieves 70.8% on SWE-Bench benchmark with 8 parallel sub-agents, MCP support, and local execution for code security. Open-sourced under Apache 2.0 in July 2026.
community_quotes: Pretty darn good and FAST compared to competitors
Love the safety of plan mode and Git isolation
Grok's reluctance to hallucinate data makes it suitable for financial applications
Much cheaper than Claude Code once running at scale

name: IBM Bob
description: Multi-agent software development platform with enhanced multi-agent tool calling, no-code agent development via watsonx Orchestrate, Bobalytics cost-and-usage dashboard, and specialized modernization workflows covering entire SDLC from planning to testing.
community_quotes: A pretty fantastic tool for program & product management work
Bob understands intent, reads complete repository context, and explains logic with clarity
Automates complex transformations and streamlines multi-step work
Built-in analytics through Bobalytics provides visibility into usage and costs
